note: Hosts that cost a run its window, with what they actually do. Written because this knowledge existed in data/research/ two days before a pass died on it twice: a research file nobody reads at the moment it matters is not a record, it is a souvenir. Every brief must carry this list, and scripts/passcheck.py prints it.
rule: Every fetch gets a hard timeout: curl -m 20, or timeout= on urllib. A host that hangs once goes on this list with the date. A hang is far worse than a refusal, because a refusal fails in a second and a hang burns the whole window.

cultural.valencia.es.cost: two Valencia passes died on it, nothing written either time
cultural.valencia.es.workaround: unknown; try valencia.es (302, responds fine) or the Generalitat catalogue instead

www.sevilla.org.cost: a Seville pass lost time before finding the mirror
www.sevilla.org.workaround: www.femas.es serves the identical municipal PDF

diario.madrid.es.workaround: none found; open in a browser session or skip

barcelona.cat.workaround: the register is already imported at data/registers/barcelona-ail.json

publico.pt.workaround: none needed, it is a newspaper and a lead rather than a source

sites.heritage.brussels.behaviour: 403 to WebFetch, 200 to curl with a browser user agent

comune.milano.it.workaround: Regione Lombardia press releases and Il Giorno surveys served as second sources instead

avrupaanitagaclar.com.symptom: COMPROMISED: serves unrelated gambling content; was cited as detail-page host for Turkish register records
avrupaanitagaclar.com.workaround: never fetch or cite; use the national registry itself

www.loc.gov.symptom: Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to plain curl and to WebFetch on every /pictures/item/ and /item/ path tried (dc1027 through dc1051 range); 403 every time, no browser UA tested
www.loc.gov.workaround: tile.loc.gov (the raw PDF/image storage host, e.g. https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/master/pnp/habshaer/dc/dc1000/dcNNNN/data/dcNNNNdata.pdf) is NOT behind the same Cloudflare gate and served most HALS survey PDFs fine this pass; note those PDFs are scanned images (JBIG2) with no text layer, so they confirm a record's existence and title but cannot be read for content without OCR

nycgovparks.org.symptom: HTTP 202 with EMPTY body to curl and WebFetch: a soft bot-block that wastes time instead of erroring
nycgovparks.org.workaround: Wayback Machine direct web.archive.org/web/<date>/ URLs (the availability API itself rate-limits)

hmdb.org.symptom: Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge to curl and WebFetch
hmdb.org.workaround: Wayback snapshots, as the DC pass used

monumentaltrees.com.workaround: browser session for fact verification only; hard rule 1 forbids content reuse anyway
